canonical_example.text: Las dos hermanas nunca se han llevado bien.
canonical_example.translation: The two sisters have never gotten along well.

canonical_example.text: Te llevo a la estación si quieres.
canonical_example.translation: I can give you a ride to the station if you like.

canonical_example.text: Ella siempre lleva sus botas favoritas cuando nieva.
canonical_example.translation: She always wears her favorite boots when it snows.

canonical_example.text: Llevo cuatro horas estudiando y todavía me queda mucho.
canonical_example.translation: I've been studying for four hours and there's still a lot left.

canonical_example.text: Solo lleva diez minutos rellenar el formulario.
canonical_example.translation: It only takes ten minutes to fill in the form.

canonical_example.text: Me llevaba dos metros de ventaja en la carrera cuando se cayó.
canonical_example.translation: He was ahead of me by two meters in the race when he fell.

canonical_example.text: Mi marido me lleva dos meses.
canonical_example.translation: My husband is two months older than me.

canonical_example.text: Sofía lleva todos los asuntos de finanzas en la familia.
canonical_example.translation: Sofía handles all the finances in the family.

canonical_example.text: ¿Quién va a llevar lo del traslado de oficina?
canonical_example.translation: ¿Who's going to deal with the office move?

canonical_example.text: Mi padre está enfermo, por lo que yo estoy llevando la empresa familiar en este momento.
canonical_example.translation: My father is sick, so I'm running the family business at the moment.

canonical_example.text: Me enteré de que cerró la fábrica. ¿Cómo lo llevas?
canonical_example.translation: I heard the factory closed down. How are you getting on?

canonical_example.text: La profesora sabe llevar a los alumnos.
canonical_example.translation: The teacher knows how to handle the students.

canonical_example.text: ¿Sabes a dónde lleva este túnel?
canonical_example.translation: Do you know where this tunnel leads to?

canonical_example.text: Lleva comidos cuatro trozos de pizza.
canonical_example.translation: She has already eaten four slices of pizza.

canonical_example.text: Se llevó todas sus pertenencias consigo.
canonical_example.translation: He took all of his belongings with him.

canonical_example.text: ¿Qué te llevarás cuando te vayas?
canonical_example.translation: What will you take with you when you go?

canonical_example.text: Se llevan mucho las zapatillas de deporte con trajes ahora.
canonical_example.translation: Wearing sneakers with a suit is really in now.

canonical_example.text: Por lo que se ve, los intrusos no se llevaron nada.
canonical_example.translation: As far as we can see, the intruders didn't take anything.

canonical_example.text: Los ladrones se llevaron los candeleros de plata.
canonical_example.translation: The thieves walked away with the silver candlesticks.

canonical_example.text: Este jarrón era de mi querida abuela Aída.
canonical_example.translation: This vase belonged to my dear granny Aida.

canonical_example.text: Tras el exilio, nunca regresó a su patria querida.
canonical_example.translation: After his exile, he never went back to his beloved country.

canonical_example.translation: Dear Manuel, I'm writing you this postcard on a rainy morning.

canonical_example.text: Sí, querida, ya saqué la basura.
canonical_example.translation: Yes, dear, I already took the trash out.

canonical_example.text: Su novio es muy querido.
canonical_example.translation: Her boyfriend is really nice.

canonical_example.text: ¡Claro que iré, querido!
canonical_example.translation: Of course I'll go, darling!

canonical_example.text: Estoy buscando un nuevo desafío.

canonical_example.translation: Look up the number in the catalog.

canonical_example.translation: I was waiting for my brother to come and pick me up for lunch.

canonical_example.translation: I need to go to fetch the flowers for the party.

canonical_example.translation: Look properly. They must be somewhere.

canonical_example.translation: We must focus on trying to find a solution to the problem.

canonical_example.translation: When I went into the club, I tried to spot my friends, but couldn't see them.

canonical_example.text: Sus ojos recorrieron la habitación, buscándola.
canonical_example.translation: His eyes went around the room, looking for her.

canonical_example.text: Ese hermano tuyo siempre anda buscando problemas.
canonical_example.translation: That brother of yours is always looking for trouble.

canonical_example.text: No busco pelea, solo quiero que me escuches.
canonical_example.translation: I'm not picking a fight. I just want you to listen to what I have to say.

canonical_example.text: Pasé la tarde buscando ofertas de vacaciones en Internet.
canonical_example.translation: I spent the afternoon searching for vacation deals on the Internet.

canonical_example.text: Se está buscado problemas si sigue así.
canonical_example.translation: He's asking for trouble if he continues like that.

canonical_example.text: Tú te lo buscaste. No culpes a nadie más.
canonical_example.translation: You brought it on yourself. Don't blame anyone else.

canonical_example.text: Sígueme y te enseño el camino a casa.
canonical_example.translation: Follow me and I will show you the way home.

canonical_example.text: Debes seguir las reglas y no romperlas.
canonical_example.translation: You must follow the rules and not break them.

canonical_example.text: Puedes parar ahora y seguir más tarde.
canonical_example.translation: You can stop now and continue later.

canonical_example.text: ¿Seguimos o prefieres tomar un descanso?
canonical_example.translation: Shall we carry on or would you rather have a break?

canonical_example.text: No podemos seguir así. Hay que hacer algo.
canonical_example.translation: We can't go on like this. We have to do something.

canonical_example.text: Mi hijo sigue en Londres por el trabajo.
canonical_example.translation: My son is still in London for work.

canonical_example.text: ¡Siga, por favor!

canonical_example.text: Siga todo recto hasta el banco y luego doble a la izquierda.

canonical_example.text: ¿Tu hermana sigue acusándote de haberle robado la pulsera?
canonical_example.translation: Is your sister still accusing you of stealing her bracelet?

canonical_example.translation: We'd better delay our departure because it is still snowing.

canonical_example.text: Por tus malas notas se sigue que no has estudiado en absoluto.
canonical_example.translation: From your bad grades, it follows that you have not studied at all.
